# TabBar

The mobile bottom tab bar (Now, Focus, Tasks, Insights, More) and the mobile top bar with the live load pill.

`CLR.TabBar` · Navigation

## Use

```jsx
<CLR.TabBar active="now" onNavigate={…} />
```

```html
<x-import component-from-global-scope="CLR.TabBar" active="now" on-navigate="{{…}}"></x-import>
```
